page_topic_one_liner: AI code completion tools — inline ghost text, FIM, and multi-line predictive suggestions in IDE
differentiator_vs_generic: IDE editor with inline ghost-text completion and multi-line suggestion highlight at cursor, NOT agent task planner or PR diff review.
visual_anchors: HERO (~50% canvas): Code editor pane with syntax-highlighted function, gray ghost-text multi-line completion trailing the cursor, and accept-tab hint chip blurred
Context file tabs ribbon: three mini open files (utils, types, test) feeding into editor via torn arrows — filenames blurred only
2x2 grid of completion vignettes (function body, import block, test stub, refactor edit) — code fragments only, no readable source
Magnifying glass zooming on ghost-text suggestion line where FIM fills middle of function
